Lateral entry train traffic manager: in 2026 Zurich Airport or Limmattal marshalling yard, by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. You will complete paid training to become a train traffic manager, which lasts eight months and is carried out in Zurich. After successfully completing your final exam, you will work in the Zurich Airport operations center / Limmattal marshalling yard and help ensure that 9,000 passenger and 2,000 freight trains reach their destination on time and safely every day. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. If you work at night, you will also receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. Possible start date: - October 1st, 2026 You can make a difference. - As a train traffic manager, you play an important role in the smooth running of rail traffic and have a major influence on customer satisfaction. - You keep track of the route network assigned to you and manage the trains running on it ecologically. - You will communicate with teammates, train drivers and control centers and be responsible for providing information to our customers at train stations. - If a disruption occurs, you react safety-oriented and quickly to restore normal operation. - In your daily work you use a wide variety of systems. Accordingly, your work is based on trust in the interaction between people and technology. Find out more about the career profile at our next career information event. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work 24-hour shifts. - Your networked thinking and your independent way of working help you to react quickly and correctly to disruptions. - You have completed a 3-year vocational apprenticeship or high school diploma. - You are fluent in the language of the training location, both verbally and in writing (level C2). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness). - During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal record and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). The document can be ordered when you are invited to get to know each other in person. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Ti aspetta un ambiente di lavoro innovativo, nel quale ti muoverai alle FFS insieme ai tuoi compagni di squadra, oltre a una formazione varia e retribuita. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Paghiamo salari aggiuntivi per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, ad es. 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Per i turni notturni verranno applicati supplementi orari compresi tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di specialista delle manovre, contribuirai a garantire che i nostri clienti viaggino in modo affidabile e puntuale spostando, formando e smontando i treni passeggeri secondo il piano di formazione dei treni. - Conduci movimenti di manovra individuali e reimposta le composizioni dei treni. - La tua responsabilità per la preparazione del treno comprende il preriscaldamento e il condizionamento dell'aria dei treni, nonché l'esecuzione delle ispezioni dei treni e delle prove dei freni. - Segnalare eventuali irregolarità, incidenti particolari o deviazioni all'autorità responsabile. - A causa della tua consapevolezza della sicurezza, è naturale per te lavorare secondo le normative. - Sei attento, concentrato e fisicamente resistente per completare con successo questo lavoro impegnativo in turni di 24 ore. ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela. Près de 14 000 collaborateurs du secteur du transport de voyageurs veillent à ce que plus de 1,3 million de clients CFF que nous transportons chaque jour puissent accéder facilement aux transports publics et se rendre d'un point A à un point B en toute sécurité et à temps. En tant que groupe professionnel central, le personnel de manœuvre y apporte une contribution essentielle. Un environnement de travail innovant vous attend, dans lequel vous évoluerez aux CFF avec vos coéquipiers, ainsi que des formations variées et rémunérées. Vous disposez également de diverses opportunités de formation interne, comme par exemple une formation pour devenir conducteur de locomotive de manœuvre. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Nous payons des salaires supplémentaires pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par ex. 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les équipes de nuit, vous recevrez des majorations de temps supplémentaires comprises entre 10 et 30 %. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que spécialiste des manœuvres, vous contribuerez à ce que nos clients voyagent de manière fiable et à l'heure en déplaçant, formant et démontant les trains de voyageurs selon le plan de formation des trains. - Vous dirigez les mouvements de manœuvre individuels et réinitialisez les compositions des trains. - Votre responsabilité en matière de préparation des trains comprend le préchauffage et la climatisation des trains ainsi que la réalisation des inspections des trains et des essais de freinage. - Vous signalez toute irrégularité, incident particulier ou écart à l'autorité compétente. - En raison de votre conscience de la sécurité, il est naturel que vous travailliez conformément à la réglementation. Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience Winterthur, from now on or by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. A varied, paid 9-month full-time training program awaits you. You will complete your theoretical training in Olten and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can move that. - As a train driver for construction trains, you make a big contribution to ensuring the renewal of the routes (tracks, gravel, etc.). - You carry out and carry out various and complex shunting movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h independently, form and dismantle them and prepare them for the journey. - In order to ensure regional logistics, you draft, apply for and order driving orders on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high level of responsibility for the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking workplace safety and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be deployed as a train driver for construction trains on the construction site and your technical skills will be required. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work in 24-hour shifts. - You are physically and mentally resilient and can act consciously and correctly with your independent way of working. - You have at least two years of recognized vocational training including a certificate of skills, ideally in the construction industry and with experience in track construction or have completed your high school diploma. - Fluent written and spoken German (level C1) is a prerequisite. - You have a category B driving license. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. Rund 14 000 Mitarbeitende des Personenverkehrs sorgen dafür, dass die über 1,3 Mio. Auf dich wartet ein innovatives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du gemeinsam mit deinen Teamkolleginnen und Teamkollegen die SBB bewegst, sowie eine abwechslungsreiche und bezahlte Ausbildung. Zudem hast du verschiedene interne Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, auch bei unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet - z.B. mit 16 Franken pro Stunde für Sonntagsarbeit. Für Nachteinsätze erhältst du zusätzlich Zeitzuschläge zwischen 10 und 30 %. Das heisst, du hast mehr Freizeit als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze.
Das kannst du bewegen.

- Während den Rangierbewegungen überwachst du die Fahrstrasse und sorgst so für die Gewährleistung der Sicherheit.
- Du erstellst die Fahrbereitschaft, gibst Daten der Sicherheits- und Informationssysteme ein und führst Bremsproben durch.
- Kleinere Mängel oder Störungen am Fahrzeug behebst du falls möglich selbst oder meldest diese mit den vorgesehenen Instrumenten der zuständigen Stelle.
- Einsätze als Rangierspezialist:in (Ai40) in vollen Touren sind für dich eine Selbstverständlichkeit. Du kuppelst und entkuppelst Schienenfahrzeuge, leitest einzelne Rangierbewegungen und stellst Zugkompositionen zurück.
Hier erfährst du mehr zum Berufsbild.
Das bringst du mit.
- Du bist aufmerksam, konzentriert und körperlich belastbar, um diese anspruchsvolle Arbeit im 24-Stunden-Schichtbetrieb erfolgreich zu bewältigen. Ausserdem arbeitest du gerne bei jedem Wetter draussen.
- Bei deiner täglichen Arbeit bedienst du unter anderem ein Tablet. Der Umgang mit modernen Arbeitsmitteln bereitet dir keine Mühe.
- Du bist bereits ausgebildete:r Lokführer:in Kat. A40
- In Deutsch bringst du in Wort und Schrift gute Kenntnisse mit.

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Bei uns führst du selbstständig ein Gleisbauteam, koordinierst Abläufe auf der Baustelle und sorgst dafür, dass Termine, Qualität und Sicherheit stimmen. Du bist mitten im Geschehen, arbeitest mit modernen Maschinen und packst selbst mit an, wenn es drauf ankommt. Freu dich auf abwechslungsreiche Projekte, ein starkes Team und echten Zusammenhalt. Dank dir und deinen Teamkolleginnen und -kollegen gelingt es der SBB, täglich über eine Million Menschen von A nach B zu transportieren.
Für folgenden Perimeter suchen wir Verstärkung: Lenzburg, Olten und Ostermundigen. Wir unterstützen Weiterentwicklungswünsche und verfügen über eine Vielzahl interner Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten für deine persönliche Laufbahn bei der SBB. Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, zum Beispiel ein kostenloses 2. Klasse GA und vergünstigte Reisen im Ausland – auch für die Familie. Auf unsere Webseite findest du weitere spannende Informationen zu unseren Benefits .
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Polier:in oder Vorarbeiter:in führst du Unterhalts- oder Erneuerungsarbeiten sowie Oberbau- und Tiefbauarbeiten im Fahrbahnbereich aus und leitest diese.
- Du stellst die technische Führung von Arbeitsstellen sicher und gewährleistest die optimale Abwicklung vor Ort; entweder für die gesamte Arbeitsstelle oder auf einen Gleisabschnitt beschränkt (bei Grossbaustellen).
- An mehreren Arbeitsstellen leitest du die Arbeiten an und übernimmst die Fachführung von Arbeitsleitern sowie Mitarbeitenden.
- Du leistest Unterstützung bei der Arbeitsvorbereitung und dem Reporting.
- Als Sicherheitschef:in triffst du Sicherheitsmassnahmen und überprüfst deren Einhaltung in Übereinstimmung mit dem Sicherheitsdispositiv.
- Die Sicherstellung des Pikettdienst verwaltest du und bei besonderen Vorkommnissen greifst du vor Ort ein.
Das bringst du mit.
- Für diese Rolle verfügst du über eine Berufslehre in der Baubranche (z.B. Verkehrswegbauer:in oder Maurer:in) und Erfahrung im Bereich Fahrbahn.
- Idealerweise hast du die Polier:in-Weiterbildung (POS oder SBV) oder die Ausbildung zur/zum Vorarbeiter:in SBV (VOS) bereits abgeschlossen.
- Als Führungskraft zeichnest du dich durch deine gute Kommunikation sowie deine Teamfähigkeit aus.
- Du bringst die Bereitschaft zu unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten und Arbeiten im Freien mit.
- Du besitzt den Führerausweis Kat. B., von Vorteil gültiger Fahrausweis Kategorie E (Anhänger).

Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. Deshalb sind weiterführende und detaillierte Informationen zum Lohnsystem bei der SBB transparent einsehbar. Diese Stelle befindet sich im Anforderungsniveau G, Regionalzulage Stufe 1. Dass du mit uns die Schweiz bewegen willst, ist für uns die grösste Motivation. Darum verzichten wir bei dieser Stelle auf ein Motivationsschreiben. Falls du uns deine Motivation dennoch mitteilen möchtest, hast du in unserem Bewerbungstool nach wie vor die Möglichkeit dazu.

Contremaître de construction de voies ou contremaître Bern Mittelland (BE/SO/AG), immédiatement ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. Chez nous, vous dirigerez de manière indépendante une équipe de construction de voies, coordonnerez les processus sur le chantier et veillerez au respect des délais, de la qualité et de la sécurité. Vous êtes au cœur de l'action, vous travaillez avec des machines modernes et vous vous impliquez lorsque cela compte le plus. Attendez-vous à des projets variés, une équipe solide et une vraie solidarité. Grâce à vous et à vos collaborateurs, les CFF peuvent transporter chaque jour plus d'un million de personnes d'un point A à un point B. Nous recherchons des renforts pour le périmètre suivant : Lenzburg, Olten et Ostermundigen. Nous soutenons vos souhaits de développement ultérieur et proposons de nombreuses possibilités de formation interne pour votre carrière personnelle aux CFF. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, par exemple une AG de 2e classe gratuite et des voyages à l'étranger à prix réduit - également pour la famille. Vous pouvez trouver des informations plus intéressantes sur nos avantages sur notre site Web. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que contremaître ou contremaître, vous réalisez et gérez des travaux d'entretien ou de rénovation ainsi que des travaux de superstructure et de génie civil dans le domaine routier. - Vous assurez la gestion technique des travaux et assurez un traitement optimal sur site ; soit pour l'ensemble du chantier, soit limité à un tronçon de voie (pour les grands chantiers). - Vous dirigerez les travaux sur plusieurs lieux de travail et prendrez en charge la gestion technique des chefs de chantier et des salariés. - Vous apportez un soutien à la préparation des travaux et au reporting. - En tant que responsable de la sécurité, vous prenez les mesures de sécurité et vérifiez leur conformité conformément à la politique de sécurité. - Vous gérez le service d'astreinte et intervenez sur site en cas d'incidents particuliers. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Pour ce rôle, vous disposez d'un apprentissage dans le secteur de la construction (par exemple constructeur de voies de circulation ou maçon) et d'une expérience dans le secteur routier. - Idéalement, vous avez déjà suivi une formation continue de contremaître (POS ou SBV) ou une formation de contremaître SBV (VOS). - En tant que manager, vous vous caractérisez par votre bonne communication et votre capacité à travailler en équipe. - Vous êtes prêt à travailler selon des horaires irréguliers et à travailler à l'extérieur. - Vous disposez d'un permis de conduire de catégorie B., un permis de conduire valide de catégorie E (remorque) est un avantage. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Ce poste est au niveau d'exigence G, niveau d'allocation régionale 1. En savoir plus sur les salaires et les avantages sociaux. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. Si vous souhaitez tout de même nous faire part de votre motivation, vous avez toujours la possibilité de le faire dans notre outil de candidature. Faire de grandes choses est plus facile si vous le faites vous-même. Cela commence par votre candidature. ## C'est comme ça que ça continue. × Vous recevrez un premier retour de notre part au plus tard 10 jours ouvrables après réception de votre candidature. Nous n'acceptons pas les dossiers des recruteurs pour ce poste. ## C'est ce que nous proposons. De plus, en tant qu'employeur, nous sommes également flexibles lorsqu'il s'agit de concilier votre vie professionnelle avec votre vie privée. ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Ti aspetta un programma di formazione a tempo pieno di 9 mesi vario e retribuito. Completerai la tua formazione teorica a Zurigo e acquisirai la tua prima esperienza pratica in uno scalo di smistamento assegnato a livello regionale. Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare e il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per goderti il ​​tempo libero mentre gli altri lavorano. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, ad esempio per il lavoro domenicale una paga oraria supplementare di 16 franchi. Per i turni notturni riceverai un bonus orario dal 10 al 30%, che ti darà più tempo libero. Puoi trovare vantaggi come AG gratuita, viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - sul nostro sito web alla voce Benefit e maggiori informazioni sul lavoro qui. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di macchinista di treni da cantiere contribuisci in modo significativo a garantire l'esecuzione dei lavori di manutenzione, rinnovamento e risoluzione dei problemi delle linee aeree. - Effettui ed effettui autonomamente vari e complessi movimenti di manovra di treni fino ad un massimo di 100 km/h, li allestisci, smonti e li prepari per il viaggio. - Per garantire la logistica regionale, redigete, richiedete e ordinate gli ordini di guida in tempo e siete responsabili della fornitura dei cantieri con i materiali necessari. - Hai un'elevata responsabilità per la sicurezza operativa dei treni da cantiere. Il controllo della sicurezza sul lavoro e la redazione di reportistica completano l'attività. - Inoltre, sarai impiegato come macchinista per i treni edili in cantiere e saranno richieste le tue competenze tecniche.

- Eseguite lavori di commutazione su sistemi di linee di contatto o impartite ordini di commutazione ed eseguite autonomamente i necessari lavori di messa a terra. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Per questo lavoro impegnativo, sei coscienzioso, affidabile, un giocatore di squadra e disposto a lavorare su turni di 24 ore. - Sei fisicamente e mentalmente resistente e puoi agire consapevolmente e correttamente con il tuo modo di lavorare indipendente. - Possiedi almeno due anni di formazione professionale riconosciuta comprensiva di un certificato di competenza, idealmente nel settore elettrico, nella costruzione metallica o nell'edilizia. - Prerequisito è la conoscenza della lingua tedesca scritta e parlata (livello C1). - Possiedi la patente di guida di categoria B. - Hai un perfetto senso dei colori (nessun punto debole del rosso/verde) e non sei iscritto nel registro penale o nelle esecuzioni.

## You can look forward to this. A varied, paid 9-month full-time training program awaits you. You will complete your theoretical training in Zurich and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts you will receive a time bonus of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can move that. - As a train driver for construction trains, you make a major contribution to ensuring that maintenance, renewal work and troubleshooting of overhead line systems are carried out. - You carry out and carry out various and complex shunting movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h independently, form and dismantle them and prepare them for the journey. - To ensure regional logistics, you draft, apply for and order driving orders on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high level of responsibility for the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking workplace safety and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be deployed as a train driver for construction trains on the construction site and your technical skills will be required.

- You carry out switching work on contact line systems or issue switching orders and carry out the necessary grounding work independently. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work in 24-hour shifts. - You are physically and mentally resilient and can act consciously and correctly with your independent way of working. - You have at least two years of recognized vocational training including a certificate of skills, ideally in the electrical industry, metal construction or construction industry. - Fluent written and spoken German (level C1) is a prerequisite. - You have a category B driving license. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register.

Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry.

descriptions.fr: Chef du service d'incendie des CFF sur site - intervention 60-100% | CFF - - - - - - Déménagez en Suisse avec nous. Chef du site des pompiers des CFF - Intervention Winterthur / Work Smart, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. Sur 15 sites en Suisse, l'intervention des pompiers des CFF veille à ce que les incidents soient traités rapidement et en toute sécurité avec 350 collaborateurs dévoués et des véhicules de secours modernes. Nous sommes à la fois spécialistes ferroviaires, conducteurs de train et pompiers et nous nous soucions 24 heures sur 24 de la sécurité de nos clients. Grâce à votre coopération, vous contribuerez à ce que le trafic ferroviaire reprenne le plus rapidement possible le bon fonctionnement. Dans le cadre de la gestion des incidents, l'intervention des CFF soutient les organismes publics d'urgence et participe activement à la prévention des événements. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - Vous gérez le site selon les principes de gestion d'entreprise et modernes, orientés client ainsi que les valeurs et les objectifs des CFF et faites partie de l'équipe de direction de la région Est. - En tant qu'interlocuteur privilégié dans le domaine de responsabilité, vous représentez les intérêts de l'intervention en matière opérationnelle auprès des partenaires internes et externes. - Assurer la gestion professionnelle des événements et le respect des normes d'intervention dans votre domaine de responsabilité est l'une de vos principales tâches. - Vous êtes responsable de la mise en œuvre des concepts et normes opérationnels ainsi que du respect de la réglementation, des exigences de qualité et de sécurité de votre secteur. - Vous assurez un leadership d'astreinte et assumez le rôle de chef d'exploitation/chef de division ferroviaire lors d'événements complexes. Vous représentez les intérêts des CFF sur les lieux de l'incident auprès des services de secours, des autorités et des services internes. - La planification et la mise en œuvre de mesures visant à promouvoir la motivation du personnel ainsi que l'élaboration active du processus de changement parmi les employés et au sein de l'organisation font également partie de votre domaine de responsabilité. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Une expérience opérationnelle et de leadership au sein des services d'urgence, de la protection civile ou de l'armée est requise pour ce poste. - Vous vous caractérisez par une pensée holistique et en réseau, des actions orientées client, du sérieux, de l'engagement et de la responsabilité personnelle. - Haute performance et orientation vers les solutions, fiabilité, capacité à travailler en équipe, solides compétences sociales, compétences en communication et en conflit ainsi qu'une apparence convaincante et gagnante sont vos points forts. - Vous avez suivi un apprentissage professionnel EFZ ou une formation équivalente, une expérience en gestion et/ou une formation complémentaire pertinente. - Vous possédez un permis de conduire de catégorie B. - Dans ce rôle, une connaissance orale et écrite de l'allemand est requise. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Ce poste est au niveau d'exigence J, niveau d'allocation régionale 1. En savoir plus sur les salaires et les avantages sociaux. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. Si vous souhaitez tout de même nous faire part de votre motivation, vous avez toujours la possibilité de le faire dans notre outil de candidature. Faire de grandes choses est plus facile si vous le faites vous-même. Cela commence par votre candidature. ## C'est comme ça que ça continue. × Vous recevrez un premier retour de notre part au plus tard 10 jours ouvrables après réception de votre candidature. Nous n'acceptons pas les dossiers des recruteurs pour ce poste. ## C'est ce que nous proposons. Les collaborateurs de l'équipe Mise en Service aux Ateliers CFF d'Yverdon-les-Bains interviennent sur les véhicules et les composants ferroviaires. Dans le cadre de révisions, réparations ou modernisations, ils effectuent des contrôles, des dépannages et de la mise en service de véhicules ferroviaires tels que les rames RABDe500 ICN, RBDe560 DO et les locomotives Re460. Attendez-vous à un travail varié et complexe ! Un intérêt marqué pour la technique est indispensable pour ce poste. descriptions.de: Lok-Inbetriebnahme- und Fehlerbehebungstechniker 100 % | CFF - - - - - - Bringen Sie mit uns die Schweiz in Bewegung. Lokomotiv-Inbetriebnahme- und Fehlerbehebungstechniker Yverdon-les-Bains, 01.09.2026 oder nach Vereinbarung, 100 % Bewerben Sie sich hier ## • Was Sie erwartet. Mitarbeiter des Inbetriebnahmeteams der CFF-Werkstätten in Yverdon-les-Bains arbeiten an Fahrzeugen und Eisenbahnkomponenten. Im Rahmen von Überholungen, Reparaturen oder Modernisierungen führen sie Prüfungen, Fehlerbehebungen und Inbetriebnahmen von Schienenfahrzeugen wie RABDe500 ICN, RBDe560 DO-Triebzügen und Re460-Lokomotiven durch. Es erwarten Sie abwechslungsreiche und komplexe • Aufgaben! Ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Technik ist für diese Position unabdingbar. Erfahrungen im Eisenbahnbereich sind von Vorteil. • Wir bieten viele Vorteile – überzeugen Sie sich selbst: Sozialleistungen. Was Sie bewegen können. - Sie stellen die Diagnose und Inbetriebnahme von Schienenfahrzeugen und Komponenten nach festgelegten Richtlinien sicher. - Sie arbeiten regelmäßig mit Ingenieuren zusammen, um komplexe Störungen zu beheben. - Gelegentlich wirken Sie in Zusammenarbeit mit der technischen Abteilung an der Entwicklung von Arbeitsdokumenten und deren Umsetzung mit. Was Sie mitbringen. - Durch Ihre berufliche Laufbahn haben Sie sich eine hervorragende Teamfähigkeit angeeignet, wissen aber auch, wie man selbstständig arbeitet. Sie sind auch zu unregelmäßigen Arbeitszeiten (2x8 Stunden oder am Wochenende) bereit. - Sie beherrschen die Fehlersuche und verfügen über mindestens drei Jahre praktische Erfahrung in diesem Bereich. - Sie verfügen über eine Ausbildung auf CFC- oder ES-Niveau im Bereich Elektrotechnik, z.B. CFC-Automatisierungsingenieur, CFC-Elektriker, ES-Techniker der Elektrotechnik. Bei ausländischen Diplomen muss mit dem Bewerbungsdossier eine offizielle eidgenössische Anerkennung für einen dieser Berufe vorgelegt werden (gesetzliche Vorschrift im Zusammenhang mit Arbeiten an unter Spannung stehenden Anlagen). - Sprachlich sprechen Sie fließend Französisch, Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. ## Ihr Gehalt und Ihre Sozialleistungen. Wir haben ein faires und progressives Gehaltssystem und setzen uns aktiv für gleiches Entgelt ein. Deshalb können zusätzliche und detaillierte Informationen zum SBB-Lohnsystem in völliger Transparenz eingesehen werden. Diese Stelle fällt unter die Anforderungsstufe E und hat Anspruch auf eine Regionalzulage der Stufe 0. Erfahren Sie mehr über Gehalt und Zusatzleistungen. ## Hier ist ein guter Anfang. Dass Sie mit uns die Schweiz bewegen wollen, ist für uns die größte Motivation. Wir verzichten daher auf die Bitte um ein Anschreiben für diese Stelle. Wenn Sie möchten, können Sie uns dennoch in unserem Bewerbungstool anschreiben. ## Fortschritt des Verfahrens. × Wir werden uns spätestens 10 Werktage nach Eingang Ihrer Bewerbung erneut bei Ihnen melden. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Willkommen im Bahntechnik Center Hägendorf. In der Montagehalle stellst du Weichen zusammen, die später direkt auf der Bahnstrecke verbaut werden. Mit deiner täglichen Arbeit sorgst du dafür, dass zentrale Elemente der Bahninfrastruktur präzise gefertigt werden und zuverlässig funktionieren. Damit leistest du einen direkten und sichtbaren Beitrag zur Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit des Bahnverkehrs. Dich erwartet eine Tätigkeit mit klaren Abläufen, Verantwortung für Qualität und Sicherheit sowie ein Team, das Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitige Unterstützung lebt. Gleichzeitig hast du die Möglichkeit, dein Fachwissen weiter auszubauen, Neues dazuzulernen und dich langfristig innerhalb des Bahnumfelds weiterzuentwickeln. Benefits wie kostenloses GA, vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland - auch für die Familie - findest du auf unserer Website unter Benefits.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Mitglied des Teams wirkst du aktiv bei der Umsetzung technischer Arbeiten im Bahninfrastrukturbereich mit und trägst so zu einem sicheren und zuverlässigen Bahnbetrieb bei.
- Du führst mechanische Montagearbeiten fachgerecht aus und gehst sicher mit Werkzeugen und Maschinen um.
- Deine Arbeit erfolgt nach klaren Vorgaben zu Qualität, Terminen und Sicherheit.
- Du prüfst ausgeführte Arbeiten sorgfältig und stellst eine saubere Ausführung sicher.
- Ausserdem bringst du dich im Team ein und unterstützt einen reibungslosen Ablauf im Arbeitsalltag.
Das bringst du mit.
- Hohes Sicherheitsbewusstsein und konsequentes Arbeiten nach geltenden Sicherheitsvorschriften ist für dich selbstverständlich.
- Praktisches technisches Verständnis sowie sicherer Umgang mit Werkzeugen und Maschinen.
- Zuverlässige, saubere und strukturierte Arbeitsweise im Arbeitsalltag.
- Abgeschlossene Berufslehre EFZ im mechanischen oder technischen Bereich, idealerweise als Gleismonteur oder mit Erfahrung in der Bahninfrastruktur.
- Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team, Einsatzbereitschaft und der Anspruch, Arbeiten sorgfältig und engagiert auszuführenKörperliche Belastbarkeit, handwerkliches Geschick und gute Koordination.

Werde Teil unseres Teams als Front- & Backoffice Spezialist:in und hilf mit deinem Dienstleistungsverständnis und Prozessdenken mit, einen wertvollen Beitrag für die Bahn von heute und morgen zu leisten.
In dieser Stelle arbeitest du im Teilzeit-Tandem mit einer Front- & Backoffice-Spezialistin des Teams.

- Du pflegst Stammdaten, erstellst Reports und unterstützt bei Monats- sowie Jahresabschlüssen.
- Du hältst den operativen Teamkolleg:innen den Rücken frei in administrativen, prozessualen oder koordinativen Herausforderungen, sodass diese die Flächenstandorte betreuen können.
Das bringst du mit.
- Dein ausgeprägtes Dienstleistungsverständnis, deine hohe Zuverlässigkeit und deine schnelle Auffassungsgabe zeichnen dich aus.
- In stressigen Situationen bleibst du ruhig und jonglierst geschickt mehrere Aufgaben. Trotz deiner hohen Detailorientierung denkst du lösungsorientiert.
- Du bringst fundierte SAP-Kenntnisse von Vorteil S/4 mit, bist sehr versiert im Umgang mit Office 365 und hast eine datenaffine Arbeitsweise.
- Du bringst eine kaufmännische Ausbildung mit und hast mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung idealerweise im Backoffice oder Einkauf. Branchenkenntnisse in der Entsorgung oder im Bahnumfeld sind ein Plus.
- Deine sehr guten Deutschkenntnisse (C1) runden dein Profil ab, wobei Französisch- und Italienischkenntnisse (B2) ein weiteres Plus sind.

Deshalb sind weiterführende und detaillierte Informationen zum Lohnsystem bei der SBB transparent einsehbar. Diese Stelle befindet sich im Anforderungsniveau I, Regionalzulage Stufe 1. Project Manager: Infrastructure Planning Zurich Altstetten / Work Smart, November 1st, 2026 or by arrangement, 60-100% (job sharing possible) Apply now ## You can look forward to this. You can look forward to working in a diverse, open-minded and helpful team that is characterized by strong cohesion and broad professional expertise. We carry out exciting and diverse projects in the area of ​​infrastructure planning and recognize the need for spatial development for transport across all horizons. We participate in the planning and control of the maintenance needs and thus support overall planning of expansion and maintenance based on routes and nodes, taking into account the operational, financial, human, material and technical capacities of the infrastructure. You independently lead the development of diverse studies and concepts in different planning horizons. In this way, you will actively participate in the further development of the railway infrastructure and help to shape sustainable mobility of the future. You can find our benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for your family - on our website under Benefits. You can move that. - You lead and develop complex studies for future expansions or renewals of the railway infrastructure based on timetable and rolling stock concepts and taking into account the necessary maintenance requirements. - In coordination with internal and external specialist departments, you define specific operating and production concepts as well as the necessary functionalities of the railway systems and incorporate these into the system strategies and the planning of the system structure. - You assess construction projects from a traffic planning perspective and determine requirements for infrastructure projects. - As part of area developments, third-party construction projects or in spatial planning instruments from the authorities, you secure the space for future network expansions. - Furthermore, you lead the development of regional master plans to define an infrastructural target image in large railway junctions. - In your area of ​​responsibility, you maintain contact with cities and municipalities, conduct negotiations and are available as the SBB contact person if you have any questions about the railway infrastructure. This is what you bring with you. - You are proactive, creative and have a quick comprehension. You act in a solution-oriented manner and never lose sight of economical and practical solutions. You think and act in the spirit of SBB without losing sight of the overall system. You also understand how to classify different interests and priorities accordingly. - You enjoy self-organized, conceptual and networked work. You also enjoy working in a team, network quickly and use your freedom of action. - You have good knowledge of the railway system and/or several years of experience in planning transport infrastructure. Good knowledge of project and portfolio management rounds off your profile. If you do not meet all the requirements but have additional qualifications and experience that are not expressly mentioned, we still look forward to receiving your application. - You have a university or technical college degree in the field of engineering, specializing in transport or infrastructure planning, geography or spatial planning, or training in a similar area. Alternatively, you have many years of professional experience in the railway industry. - Your communication is tailored to your target group and you negotiate in a goal-oriented manner with a wide range of partners. In German, you communicate fluently and stylistically, both verbally and in writing (at least B2). Knowledge of French is an advantage. ## Your salary and your benefits. descriptions.fr: Chef de projet : en planification des infrastructures 60-100% | CFF - - - - - - Déménagez en Suisse avec nous. Chef de projet : Planification des infrastructures Zurich Altstetten / Work Smart, 1er novembre 2026 ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% (partage d'emploi possible) Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela avec impatience. Vous pouvez vous attendre à travailler dans une équipe diversifiée, ouverte d’esprit et serviable, caractérisée par une forte cohésion et une vaste expertise professionnelle. Nous réalisons des projets passionnants et diversifiés dans le domaine de la planification des infrastructures et reconnaissons la nécessité d'un développement spatial pour les transports à travers tous les horizons. Nous participons à la planification et au contrôle des besoins de maintenance et soutenons ainsi la planification globale de l'expansion et de la maintenance en fonction des itinéraires et des nœuds, en tenant compte des capacités opérationnelles, financières, humaines, matérielles et techniques de l'infrastructure. Vous dirigez de manière indépendante le développement de diverses études et concepts dans différents horizons de planification. Vous participerez ainsi activement au développement futur de l’infrastructure ferroviaire et contribuerez à façonner la mobilité durable de demain. Vous trouverez nos avantages tels que les allocations familiales, l'AG de 2e classe gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduits - également pour votre famille - sur notre site Internet sous Avantages. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - Vous conduisez et développez des études complexes pour les extensions ou renouvellements futurs de l'infrastructure ferroviaire basés sur des concepts d'horaires et de matériel roulant et en tenant compte des besoins de maintenance nécessaires. - En coordination avec des services spécialisés internes et externes, vous définissez des concepts d'exploitation et de production spécifiques ainsi que les fonctionnalités nécessaires des systèmes ferroviaires et vous les intégrez dans les stratégies système et la planification de la structure du système. - Vous évaluez les projets de construction du point de vue de la planification du trafic et déterminez les exigences des projets d'infrastructure. - Dans le cadre d'aménagements de zone, de projets de construction de tiers ou d'instruments d'aménagement du territoire des autorités, vous sécurisez l'espace pour de futures extensions de réseau. - Par ailleurs, vous pilotez l'élaboration de schémas directeurs régionaux pour définir une image cible infrastructurelle dans les grands nœuds ferroviaires. - Dans votre domaine de responsabilité, vous entretenez le contact avec les villes et les communes, menez les négociations et êtes disponible en tant qu'interlocuteur des CFF si vous avez des questions sur l'infrastructure ferroviaire. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous êtes proactif, créatif et avez une compréhension rapide. Vous agissez de manière orientée vers les solutions et ne perdez jamais de vue les solutions économiques et pratiques. Vous pensez et agissez dans l’esprit des CFF sans perdre de vue l’ensemble du système. Definirai attivamente la gestione finanziaria della divisione di produzione del trasporto passeggeri e svilupperai ulteriormente il concetto di controllo insieme a diversi reparti specializzati. In un ambiente interdisciplinare all'interfaccia tra controllo, contabilità, pianificazione e IT, guiderai l'ulteriore sviluppo del panorama del controllo, in particolare nel contesto di SAP S 4HANA. Puoi aspettarti un ambiente entusiasmante ad alto impatto, libertà creativa diversificata e stretta collaborazione con le parti interessate centrali del business e dell'IT. Le forme di lavoro flessibili nell’ambito di Work Smart vi supportano in questo. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di consulente di controllo, sei la persona di contatto centrale per le questioni di controllo tecnico all'interno della divisione e garantisci l'attuazione delle specifiche a livello di gruppo, l'ulteriore sviluppo del concetto specialistico e l'armonizzazione con i processi aziendali. - Supporti lo sviluppo di soluzioni sostenibili nell'ambito di SAP S/4HANA e garantisci processi stabili e sostenibili nel funzionamento parallelo. - Traduci tecnicamente i processi aziendali in flussi di valore end-to-end e garantisci la corretta mappatura in CO e FI, coordini i requisiti tra business, gestione specialistica, organizzazione dei servizi di controllo e IT e accompagni l'implementazione fino all'approvazione tecnica. - Garantisci il rispetto dei sistemi di governance, controllo e controllo interno e assumi un ruolo di garanzia della qualità all'interno della divisione. - Sarai responsabile della fatturazione interna dei servizi, delle attribuzioni e delle fatture speciali e del mantenimento dei relativi dati anagrafici e delle chiavi di fatturazione secondo il principio del prezzo di costo. - Preparate le basi per decisioni, rischi e progressi in modo appropriato per il gruppo target e consigliate la direzione e le parti interessate su un piano di parità. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Quando lavori insieme, impressioni con lo spirito di squadra, la comunicazione chiara e un comportamento fiducioso nella gestione delle parti interessate. - Con forza analitica e concettuale, comprendi i processi end-to-end e trovi modi pragmatici e orientati alla soluzione. - Hai una conoscenza approfondita di SAP - idealmente sia R/3 che S/4HANA - in particolare nei moduli CO e FI. Hai anche esperienza nell'applicazione di standard e manuali di controllo, nonché nella valutazione di casi aziendali complessi. - Richiediamo una laurea in economia aziendale con specializzazione in finanza o un perfezionamento come esperto in contabilità e controllo. Controlling Advisor (m/f/d) Bern / Work Smart, immediately or by arrangement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. You will actively shape the financial management of the Passenger Transport Production Division and further develop the controlling concept together with various specialist departments. In an interdisciplinary environment at the interface of controlling, accounting, planning and IT, you will drive the further development of the controlling landscape, especially in the context of SAP S 4HANA. You can expect an exciting environment with high impact, diverse creative freedom and close collaboration with central stakeholders from business and IT. Flexible forms of work as part of Work Smart support you in this. You can move that. - As a controlling advisor, you are the central contact person for technical controlling issues within the division and ensure the implementation of group-wide specifications, the further development of the specialist concept and the harmonization with the business processes. - You support the development of sustainable solutions within the framework of SAP S/4HANA and ensure stable and sustainable processes in parallel operation. - You translate business processes technically into end-to-end value flows and ensure the correct mapping in CO and FI, coordinate requirements between business, specialist management, controlling service organization and IT and accompany the implementation until technical approval. - You ensure compliance with governance, controlling and internal control systems and take on a quality assurance role within the division. - You will be responsible for internal service billing, allocations and special billing and maintaining the relevant master data and billing keys according to the cost price principle. - You prepare the basis for decisions, risks and progress in a way that is appropriate for the target group and advises management and stakeholders on an equal footing. This is what you bring with you. - When working together, you impress with team spirit, clear communication and a confident demeanor in stakeholder management. - With analytical and conceptual strength, you understand end-to-end processes and find pragmatic, solution-oriented ways. - You have in-depth knowledge of SAP - ideally both R/3 and S/4HANA - especially in the CO and FI modules. You also have experience in applying controlling standards and manuals as well as in assessing complex business cases. - We require a university degree in business administration with a focus on finance or further training as an expert in accounting and controlling. You also have several years of experience in controlling and accounting as well as in dealing with complex value flows and governance issues. - You speak German at level C2 and ideally have another national language at level A1. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. Project Manager Energy - Digital Building Berna / Work Smart, 1 settembre 2026 o previo accordo, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. La divisione Energia FFS fornisce alle ferrovie svizzere in modo sicuro, economico e sostenibile corrente di trazione a 16,7 Hz con i propri impianti di produzione di energia elettrica e una rete di distribuzione estesa a tutta la Svizzera. Maggiori informazioni su Energia FFS: Link Nell'ambito dell'ulteriore sviluppo del settore aziendale Energia verranno gradualmente sviluppati e introdotti processi, ruoli e standard per l'utilizzo del BIM. L’obiettivo è rendere i processi di pianificazione, costruzione e operativi più efficienti e trasparenti attraverso la digitalizzazione. Contract Manager:in Grundstücke Zürich / Work Smart, 01.08.2026 or by agreement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to it. An innovative working environment awaits you, in which you participate in the conception and implementation of important changes and make a tangible contribution to the success of SBB. You work independently and in a team, develop solutions for existing challenges and implement them independently or together with your colleagues. Your commitment increases the satisfaction of our customers, strengthens cooperation with external partners and offers you a wide range of development opportunities. Benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - can be found on our website under Benefits. You can move that. - As a contract manager: you are responsible for the management of real estate contracts such as building rights, conduction and transmission management contracts and other easements and represent the interests of SBB in construction projects. Through structured invoicing and payments including country index of consumer prices adjustments (LIK), you manage the commercial processes and negotiate compensation, extensions and renewals of transit, transmission line and building rights contracts as well as the expiration of long-term contracts. - You comprehensively review and control contracts, create agreements and are the contact person for landowners. - You are responsible for the data quality independently, develop the working technology further and advise on the optimization of processes. - You take on special and higher-level assignments independently and bear the responsibility for timely and high-quality implementation. With your drive and your organizational skills, you can handle multiple dossiers, requests and topics simultaneously, efficiently and reliably, set priorities correctly and drive topics forward. Thanks to your high social skills, you communicate clearly, proactively and appropriately, are customer-oriented and enjoy the exchange with various internal and external stakeholders and your teammates. As an open-minded person, you actively approach others, build sustainable relationships and maintain your network with an open, accessible and authentic demeanor. Your way of working is characterized by energy, flexibility, willingness to learn, a high level of initiative and a presence in the team. - We presuppose a commercial or technical vocational degree EFZ (e.g. in the real estate, notarial or trust area), as well as basic knowledge and experience at the administrative level in real estate law, real estate law and ideally in dealing with systems such as SAP RE-FX. Negotiable oral and written knowledge of German as well as at best good knowledge of French and/or Italian (minimum B2) are required for this function. ## Your wages and benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information on the wage system is transparently visible at SBB. You complete your theoretical training in Olten or Zurich Altstetten and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. After training there is the opportunity to work part-time. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. Whether independently or in a team, your work has a direct impact on safe and punctual rail traffic. You can expect a varied environment with responsibility and visible effect. You benefit from a state-of-the-art workplace, a canteen with fair prices, free work clothes including cleaning and attractive allowances for families. We promote your further development in signal technology and production. Collaboration in a team gives you pleasure, at the same time you can independently plan and implement tasks and actively shape improvements (KAIZEN / 5S). - Practical experience in assembly or assembly production is advantageous; You are also confident in reading technical drawings and guidelines. - There is a completed basic mechanical training EFZ, for example as an automatic engineer:in, automatic installer:in or polymechanic:in the field of assembly, or an equivalent qualification. - Basic knowledge of MS Office, especially in Outlook, Excel and Word, round off your profile and German language skills are at least level B2. Here you will find an insight into our railway technology center - BTC Hägendorf. ## Your wages and benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. descriptions.it: Responsabile mandati, macchinista lavori di manutenzione binari ferroviari 60-100% | CFF - - - - - - Fate muovere la Svizzera con noi. Responsabile del mandato, macchinista dei lavori ferroviari Biel/Bienne, 01.09.2026 o da concordare, 60-100% Candidati qui ## Cosa ti aspetta. Siete appassionati di infrastrutture ferroviarie e vorreste far parte di un team dinamico al centro dei progetti di manutenzione ferroviaria nel Giura? Ti interesserebbe il ruolo di capotreno che coordina le esigenze tecniche dei cantieri di manutenzione ferroviaria, i requisiti di sicurezza, le misure operative nonché la direzione dei lavori? Questa posizione è per te! Cosa puoi fare muovere. - Assumersi la responsabilità dei mandati e garantire l'attuazione/esecuzione di mandati di manutenzione monodisciplinari, comprese piccole missioni multidisciplinari. - Supervisionare e coordinare le squadre tecniche locali per garantire la qualità degli interventi. - Collaborare con partner interni ed esterni per realizzare progetti complessi. - Garantire lo svolgimento dei lavori e il controllo finanziario dei mandati. Cosa porti. - Esperienza significativa nel settore ferroviario, preferibilmente su progetti ferroviari. - Conoscenza delle norme e dei regolamenti in vigore e preferibilmente formazione confermata sulla gestione della sicurezza RTE 20100. - Buono spirito di squadra e capacità di lavorare sul campo, in collaborazione con team locali. - Buone capacità di gestione dei progetti e di problem solving tecnico. - Patente per autoveicoli di categoria B. - Parli correntemente il francese (livello C1), una buona conoscenza del tedesco (livello B2) costituirà titolo preferenziale. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Per questo motivo è possibile consultare in tutta trasparenza informazioni aggiuntive e dettagliate sul sistema salariale delle FFS. Responsabile del traffico ferroviario con ingresso laterale: a Muttenz, previo accordo, 100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. In qualità di responsabile della circolazione ferroviaria, tenete d'occhio la rete di tratte che vi è stata assegnata nello scalo di smistamento di Basilea, dirigete e monitorate i treni sul posto di lavoro con circa sei-otto schermi. Inoltre tramite una pulsantiera è possibile impostare le diverse corse di manovra e dei treni. Durante il normale funzionamento monitorate il traffico, controllate i processi e assicurate che tutto funzioni senza intoppi. In caso di interruzioni assumete la gestione operativa: analizzate la situazione, avviate misure e risolvete l'interruzione affinché la normalità venga ripristinata il più rapidamente possibile. Ciò significa che condividete la responsabilità della mobilità in Svizzera. Senza di te Internet si ferma. Il lavoro è rilevante per il sistema ed è immediatamente efficace: coordini persone e tecnologia, prendi decisioni rapide e quindi contribuisci direttamente alla sicurezza e all'affidabilità del trasporto ferroviario. Ti offriamo una formazione secondaria retribuita per diventare responsabile della circolazione ferroviaria, della durata di otto mesi. Dopo aver superato con successo l'esame finale, lavorerai nello scalo di smistamento di Basilea e contribuirai a garantire che 2000 treni merci arrivino ogni giorno a destinazione in modo sicuro e puntuale. Scopri di più sul profilo professionale al prossimo evento informativo. Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare e il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per goderti il ​​tempo libero mentre gli altri lavorano. Per il lavoro notturno e domenicale paghiamo un salario supplementare, ad esempio per il lavoro domenicale una paga oraria supplementare di 16 franchi. Per i turni notturni ricevi un'indennità dal 10 al 30%, che ti dà più tempo libero. I vantaggi come AG gratuita e viaggi all'estero scontati - anche per la famiglia - potete trovarli sul nostro sito web alla voce Vantaggi. Possibili date di inizio: - 1 febbraio 2027 - 1 giugno 2027 - 1 ottobre 2027 Puoi far sì che ciò accada. - In qualità di responsabile del traffico ferroviario nello scalo di smistamento di Basilea, tieni d'occhio la rete di collegamenti che ti è stata assegnata, dirigi i treni in modo sicuro ed ecologico e monitori il traffico. - Durante le operazioni regolari, garantite che i transiti internazionali dei treni merci (Germania – Francia) si svolgano senza intoppi. - In caso di interruzioni, si adottano misure per ripristinare la normalità. - Coordini e comunichi con i compagni di squadra, il personale delle locomotive e il personale di costruzione e di manovra in Svizzera. Ti coordinerai inoltre con i gestori del traffico ferroviario per il trasporto merci transfrontaliero. - Sei responsabile delle informazioni sui clienti nelle stazioni ferroviarie e garantisci comunicazioni chiare e tempestive. - Grazie al vostro impegno i treni passeggeri e merci viaggiano in sicurezza e puntuali 24 ore su 24. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Sei affidabile, ti piace lavorare in team e sei disposto a lavorare su turni 24 ore su 24. - Pensi in modo strutturato e in rete. Nelle situazioni stressanti agisci rapidamente e con attenzione. descriptions.en: Lateral entry train traffic manager: in 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train traffic manager: in Muttenz, by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train traffic manager, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you in the Basel marshalling yard, direct and monitor the trains at your workplace with around six to eight screens. In addition, you can set the various shunting and train journeys using a push-button signal box. During normal operation, you monitor the traffic, control the processes and ensure that things run smoothly. In the event of disruptions, you take over operational management: you analyze the situation, initiate measures and resolve the disruption so that normality is restored as quickly as possible. This means you share responsibility for mobility in Switzerland. Without you the internet comes to a standstill. The job is system-relevant and immediately effective: you coordinate people and technology, make quick decisions and thus make a direct contribution to the safety and reliability of rail transport. We offer you paid secondary training to become a train traffic manager, which lasts eight months. After successfully completing your final exam, you will work in the Basel marshalling yard and help ensure that 2,000 freight trains reach their destination safely and on time every day. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and Sunday work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. Possible start dates: - February 1st, 2027 - June 1st, 2027 - October 1st, 2027 You can make this happen. - As a train traffic manager in the Basel marshalling yard, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you, direct trains safely and ecologically and monitor traffic. - During regular operations, you ensure that the international transits of freight trains (Germany – France) are carried out smoothly. - In the event of disruptions, you take measures to restore normality. - You coordinate and communicate with teammates, locomotive personnel as well as construction and shunting personnel in Switzerland. You will also coordinate with the train traffic managers for cross-border freight transport. - You are responsible for customer information at train stations and ensure clear, timely communications. - Thanks to your efforts, passenger and freight trains travel safely and on time around the clock. This is what you bring with you. - You are reliable, enjoy working in a team and are willing to work 24-hour shifts. - You think in a structured and networked way. In stressful situations you act quickly and carefully. Technical affinity is promoted during training. - For the intensive and demanding training period, you bring a lot of personal responsibility and willingness to learn and are motivated to get involved in different learning environments - from face-to-face lessons on site to digital self-study. - You have completed at least three years of vocational training or a high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - You are confident in German at level C2 and ideally have French at level A1. You also have a perfect sense of color with no red-green weakness. - During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal record and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). The document can be ordered when you are invited to get to know each other in person. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. As a train traffic manager, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you, direct and monitor the trains at your workplace with around eight screens. During normal operation, you monitor the traffic, control the processes and ensure that things run smoothly. In the event of disruptions, you take over operational management: you analyze the situation, initiate measures and resolve the disruption so that normality is restored as quickly as possible. This means you share responsibility for mobility in Switzerland. Without you the internet comes to a standstill. The job is system-relevant and immediately effective: you coordinate people and technology, make quick decisions and thus make a direct contribution to the safety and reliability of rail transport.
• We offer you paid secondary training to become a train traffic manager, which lasts eight months. After successfully completing your final exam, you will work in the operations center at Zurich Airport or in the Limmattal marshalling yard and help ensure that 9,000 passenger and 2,000 freight trains reach their destination safely and on time every day. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and Sunday work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. Responsable du trafic ferroviaire à entrée latérale: à l'aéroport de Zurich ou à la gare de triage de Limmattal, sur rendez-vous, 100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. En tant que responsable du trafic ferroviaire, vous surveillez le réseau de lignes qui vous est attribué, dirigez et surveillez les trains sur votre lieu de travail avec environ huit écrans. En fonctionnement normal, vous surveillez le trafic, contrôlez les processus et veillez au bon déroulement des opérations. En cas de perturbations, vous prenez en charge la gestion opérationnelle : vous analysez la situation, engagez des mesures et résolvez la perturbation afin que la normalité revienne le plus rapidement possible. Cela signifie que vous partagez la responsabilité de la mobilité en Suisse. Sans vous, Internet s’arrête. Le travail est pertinent pour le système et immédiatement efficace : vous coordonnez les personnes et la technologie, prenez des décisions rapides et contribuez ainsi directement à la sécurité et à la fiabilité du transport ferroviaire. Nous vous proposons une formation secondaire rémunérée pour devenir gestionnaire du trafic ferroviaire, d'une durée de huit mois. Après avoir réussi votre examen final, vous travaillerez au centre opérationnel de l'aéroport de Zurich ou dans la gare de triage de Limmattal et contribuerez à ce que 9 000 trains de voyageurs et 2 000 trains de marchandises arrivent chaque jour à destination en toute sécurité et à temps. Découvrez-en davantage sur le profil de carrière lors du prochain événement d’information. Vous considérez les horaires de travail irréguliers et le travail posté comme un avantage pour profiter de votre temps libre pendant que d'autres travaillent. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et le dimanche, par exemple avec un salaire horaire supplémentaire de 16 francs pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les quarts de nuit, vous bénéficiez d'une indemnité de temps de 10 à 30 %, ce qui vous laisse plus de temps libre. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous êtes fiable, aimez travailler en équipe et êtes prêt à travailler 24 heures sur 24. - Vous réfléchissez de manière structurée et en réseau. Votre motivation est plus importante pour nous que le secteur dont vous êtes issu. - En allemand vous êtes confiant au niveau C2. Project manager: in technical systems/electrical systems 50Hz Zurich Altstetten / Work Smart, January 1st, 2027 or by arrangement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. In this versatile role, you represent the interests of the client in demanding infrastructure projects in the area of ​​technical and electrical systems (50 Hz). Your field of activity includes platforms, tunnels, railway technical rooms and buildings along the railway infrastructure. You take on the role of builder in multidisciplinary project teams and manage external planning and execution partners throughout the entire project life cycle. In doing so, you ensure that requirements regarding safety, quality, cost-effectiveness and sustainability are met. A dedicated team of generalists with a broad technical background awaits you, who will support you as you get started and offer you a varied and responsible working environment. With “Work Smart” you can organize your everyday working life flexibly – in the office, in the home office or on the go. You can move that. - You represent the interests of the client in all project phases - from strategic planning through tendering and awarding to implementation and commissioning. - You are responsible for achieving the project goals in terms of costs, deadlines, quality, safety and functionality. - You control and coordinate external planning offices, entrepreneurs and specialists and ensure efficient collaboration between all those involved. - You ensure compliance with standards, guidelines, legal requirements and client requirements. - You carry out transparent contract, supplementary and claims management and identify opportunities and risks at an early stage in order to initiate suitable measures for successful project management. - You act as a central interface between the client, project teams, authorities, operating organizations and other stakeholders. This is what you bring with you. - For you, teamwork is the basis of successful projects and you enjoy working in an interdisciplinary manner. - You have strong analytical, conceptual and organizational skills as well as entrepreneurial thinking. You act independently, structured and solution-oriented and impress with your strong communication skills and assertiveness. - You have several years of experience in project management, project control or client representation of electrical, energy or building technology systems. - Knowledge of public procurement as well as contract and supplementary management is an advantage. You are familiar with SIA's service and contract models as well as the relevant standards and guidelines in the area of ​​electrical and infrastructure systems. - You have a university degree (FH/ETH/University) or higher vocational training (HF, federal specialist certificate or federal diploma) in the field of electrical engineering, energy supply or building technology. - You communicate stylishly in German; Knowledge of another national language is an advantage. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level J, regional allowance level 2. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. Votre domaine d'activité comprend les quais, les tunnels, les locaux techniques ferroviaires et les bâtiments situés le long de l'infrastructure ferroviaire. Vous connaissez les modèles de services et de contrats de SIA ainsi que les normes et directives pertinentes dans le domaine des systèmes électriques et des infrastructures. - Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire (FH/ETH/Université) ou d'une formation professionnelle supérieure (HF, certificat fédéral de spécialité ou diplôme fédéral) dans le domaine de l'électrotechnique, de l'approvisionnement en énergie ou de la technique du bâtiment. - Vous communiquez avec style en allemand ; La connaissance d'une autre langue nationale est un avantage. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Fachsupport und Businessanalyst (m/w/d) Logistik Bern / Work Smart, 01.08.2026 oder nach Vereinbarung, 60-100% Jetzt bewerben ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen. Als Fachsupport und Business Analyst bei SBB Infrastruktur treibst du gemeinsam im agilen Team die Weiterentwicklung der Logistikprozesse in der Supply Chain voran. Dazu gehören insbesondere die Materialwirtschaft mit SAP MM/IM, Transportmanagement mit SAP LE-TRA und das Labelmanagement im Logistikumfeld. Du stehst in engem Austausch mit Anwender:innen und Expert:innen, welche die Versorgung der Baustellen und Produktion sicherstellen. Ein hochmotiviertes und interdisziplinäres Team mit aktuellem Bahn- und Technologiewissen unterstützt dich bei deinen Herausforderungen. Das kannst du bewegen. - Du sicherst einen stabilen Applikationsbetrieb im DevOps Setup und gestaltest die künftige Systemlandschaft mit SAP S/4HANA mit, damit die Supply Chain zuverlässig funktioniert. - Anfragen aus dem 1st Level Support beantwortest du zeitnah und begleitest Anwenderinnen und Anwender bei neuen oder geänderten Funktionen. - Den 2nd Level Applikationssupport stellst du sicher und koordinierst Change Requests mit externen Partnern. - Neue Business Anforderungen identifizierst du und stimmst sie mit Prozess und Produktmanagement zur Weiterentwicklung der Systeme ab. - Als Schnittstelle bringst du Management, Fachbereiche, IT und Systemprovider zusammen und sorgst für die Abstimmung fachlicher und technischer Anforderungen. - Du pflegst spezifische Stammdaten, testest Releases und erstellst sowie aktualisierst Dokumentationen und Schulungsunterlagen. Das bringst du mit. - Du überzeugst mit Team und Kundenorientierung, starken analytischen und konzeptionellen Fähigkeiten, klarer Kommunikation und Verantwortungsbewusstsein. - Hohe Eigeninitiative, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie vernetztes und unternehmerisches Denken zeichnen dich aus, zudem lernst du gerne und arbeitest dich in neue und komplexe Themen ein. - Empathisches Auftreten und eine aktive Feedbackkultur sind dir wichtig, du bringst dich ein und entwickelst dich kontinuierlich weiter. - Sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse in den SAP Logistikmodulen, insbesondere in SAP MM und IM sowie SAP LE-TRA, ergänzt durch Erfahrung an den Schnittstellen zu SAP SD setzen wir voraus. - Ein Abschluss EFZ mit berufsbegleitender Weiterbildung auf Stufe Höhere Fachschule oder CAS in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Betriebswirtschaft oder ein abgeschlossenes Studium bringst du mit. - Du hast sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf Niveau C1 und kannst dich auf Englisch (B2) sehr gut verständigen. ## Dein Lohn und deine Benefits. descriptions.en: Specialist support and business analyst (m/f/d) logistics 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Specialist support and business analyst (m/f/d) Logistics Bern / Work Smart, August 1st, 2026 or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a specialist support and business analyst at SBB Infrastructure, you will drive the further development of logistics processes in the supply chain together in an agile team. This includes, in particular, materials management with SAP MM/IM, transport management with SAP LE-TRA and label management in the logistics environment. You are in close contact with users and experts who ensure supplies to construction sites and production. A highly motivated and interdisciplinary team with up-to-date rail and technology knowledge supports you in your challenges. You can move that. - You ensure stable application operation in the DevOps setup and help shape the future system landscape with SAP S/4HANA so that the supply chain functions reliably. - You will answer inquiries from 1st level support promptly and support users with new or changed functions. - You ensure 2nd level application support and coordinate change requests with external partners. - You identify new business requirements and coordinate them with process and product management to further develop the systems. - As an interface, you bring together management, departments, IT and system providers and ensure that professional and technical requirements are coordinated. - You maintain specific master data, test releases and create and update documentation and training materials. This is what you bring with you. - You impress with your team and customer orientation, strong analytical and conceptual skills, clear communication and sense of responsibility. - You are characterized by a high level of initiative, a structured way of working and networked and entrepreneurial thinking. You also enjoy learning and familiarizing yourself with new and complex topics. - An empathetic demeanor and an active feedback culture are important to you; you get involved and continuously develop yourself. - We require very good user knowledge of the SAP logistics modules, especially in SAP MM and IM as well as SAP LE-TRA, supplemented by experience in the interfaces to SAP SD. - You bring an EFZ degree with part-time further training at the higher technical school level or CAS in computer science, business informatics or business administration or a completed degree. - You have very good knowledge of German at level C1 and can communicate very well in English (B2). ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level I, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision July 2026 Application Final decision July 2026 Any questions? We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. ## Cosa ti aspetta. Contribuisci a progettare infrastrutture ferroviarie sicure e affidabili con un impatto diretto per i clienti. Ti evolverai in un ambiente variegato all'interno del team Romandie Structures Engineering, dove la collaborazione e il trasferimento di conoscenze sono sperimentati quotidianamente. Durante i primi due anni beneficerai di una formazione approfondita incentrata sul settore ferroviario e migliorerai continuamente. Attualmente a Renens sono vacanti due posti di lavoro. Uno ha come zona principale la linea del Vallese, compreso l'Alto Vallese. La seconda zona principale è la linea Giura–Neuchâtel.
